root_cause.text: In `drivers/net/ethernet/wangxun/libwx/wx_hw.c`, `wx_sw_init()` unconditionally derived `wx->bus.func` by reading the PF-only MMIO register `WX_CFG_PORT_ST`, so VF initialization performed an illegal register access because VFs are not permitted to read that register.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `wx_sw_init()` from `FIELD_GET(WX_CFG_PORT_ST_LANID, rd32(wx, WX_CFG_PORT_ST))` to `PCI_FUNC(pdev->devfn)` when `pdev->is_virtfn` is true, and the commit message states `WX_CFG_PORT_ST is a PF restricted register` and that reading it during VF initialization triggers an illegal access and system hang.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix wx_sw_init() to set the bus function correctly for SR-IOV virtual functions by using PCI_FUNC() instead of reading the port status register.
intent_record.what: The initialization of wx->bus.func in wx_sw_init() was changed from always reading the LAN ID field out of WX_CFG_PORT_ST to conditionally using PCI_FUNC(pdev->devfn) when pdev->is_virtfn is true, while keeping the original register-based extraction for non-virtual functions.
intent_record.how: For SR-IOV virtual functions, the driver now derives the function number from the PCI device function in devfn instead of relying on hardware port status registers, which may not provide the correct value for VFs. This ensures wx->bus.func is initialized correctly for virtual functions and preserves the existing behavior for PFs.

grouping_result.intent: Fix wx_sw_init() to set the bus function correctly for SR-IOV virtual functions by using PCI_FUNC() instead of reading the port status register.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly fixes the reported root cause: it stops VF initialization from reading the PF-only MMIO register and instead derives the bus function with PCI_FUNC(), avoiding the illegal access.

candidates.rationale: This statement is part of the pre-fix logic that derived the bus function from the PF-only WX_CFG_PORT_ST register, which VFs are not allowed to read, causing illegal register access during VF initialization.
This read of the PF-only WX_CFG_PORT_ST MMIO register is the direct illegal access on VF paths; it is the immediate operation that triggers the vulnerability.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement unconditionally reads the PF-only WX_CFG_PORT_ST MMIO register to derive wx->bus.func. On VF initialization, that register access is illegal and is the root cause of the vulnerability.
This is the exact MMIO register read from the PF-only WX_CFG_PORT_ST register. It directly causes the illegal access when executed by a VF.
